Trains and ferries in Thailand

The useful train is Bangkok to Chiang Mai on SRT 9 and 10. The useful boats are Lomprayah on the Gulf and morning Andaman ferries to Phi Phi.

North trainSRT 9 and 10, Krung Thep Aphiwat to Chiang Mai
Gulf boatsLomprayah and Seatran
Andaman boatsMorning only in the wet months

Long-distance trains now use Krung Thep Aphiwat Central Terminal, not Hua Lamphong, for the Chiang Mai sleepers. Budget a Grab from your hotel; the station is north of the old core.

Book trains on SRT or via Trip.com when inventory is mirrored. Book Gulf ferries the afternoon before. Book Andaman boats when the weather desk is awake, not a week out in September.

What to book

Bangkok to Chiang MaiSRT 9/10 sleeper or flightTrain is the experience. Flight is the day-saver.
Bangkok to Phuket or KrabiFlightThe train south is not the first-trip move.
Samui to Phangan or TaoLomprayahMorning seats in swell season.
Phuket to Phi Phi or KrabiFerry or speedboatCancel when the Andaman is up.

Common questions

Hua Lamphong or Krung Thep Aphiwat?
For Chiang Mai sleepers 9 and 10, use Krung Thep Aphiwat. Hua Lamphong is still a station; it is not your sleeper.
